scenario_description: Elena has a confirmed daytime substitute assignment at Franklin Park Elementary on June 11. Because she will already be at the school, the principal is trying to fill an optional paid host role for that evening's family literacy night. The initial inquiry does not establish whether a substitute may accept the role, whether the timing fits, or whether it is paid. The opportunity becomes sufficiently observable at event4, when the coordinator confirms that Elena may add the role to her assignment and the principal confirms the $90 payment, exact hours, and responsibilities. Later messages provide the response deadline and preparation details. Proactively confirming the add-on with the principal and coordinator and placing it on Elena's calendar could provide worthwhile extra income without another trip, while ignoring it causes no loss.

parameter.subject: June 11 substitute assignment confirmed
parameter.body: Your substitute assignment is confirmed for Thursday, June 11, 2026, at Franklin Park Elementary, 2801 Summit Street, Columbus, Ohio. Report to the main office by 7:30 AM. Your classroom coverage is scheduled to end at 2:45 PM.

parameter.subject: Possible evening role at Franklin Park
parameter.body: Since you are scheduled to be at Franklin Park on June 11, I wanted to ask whether you might be interested in helping with our family literacy night that evening. We are looking for someone to welcome families and help them find the reading activities. I am checking whether one of our substitute teachers can take this role and will send more details if it is possible.

parameter.subject: Substitute participation in family literacy night
parameter.body: I checked the district staffing rules after the principal's inquiry. A substitute may accept an evening family event after a daytime assignment when the principal adds the role to the work record. I am still waiting for the principal to confirm the hours, duties, and payment before I can approve the add-on.

parameter.subject: Optional paid host role confirmed for June 11
parameter.body: The optional family literacy night runs from 4:30 PM to 6:30 PM on Thursday, June 11, immediately after your classroom assignment at Franklin Park. We can add you as the host, pay an additional $90, and provide the activity materials at the school. The role is to welcome families, explain the reading stations, and help reset the room afterward. Please let Luis Ortega and me know if you would like to take it.

parameter.subject: Details for June 11 family literacy night
parameter.body: If you accept the host role, please arrive in the library by 4:15 PM for a short room check. The welcome table will have the family sign-in sheets and station map. We need your confirmation by Wednesday, June 10 at noon so we can print the name sign and update the staffing list.

parameter.subject: June 11 evening add-on still available
parameter.body: The June 11 family literacy night add-on remains open for you. I have not added the extra hours to your work record yet because I am waiting for your confirmation. The principal's noon Wednesday deadline is the last point at which we can update the staffing list.
